title: MatchMetadata
description: SEO metadata contract for match pages, including title, description, and social sharing tags

title.description: SEO-optimized page title for search engines and browser tabs
title.pattern: ^.+ vs .+( Live Score Ball by Ball| Final Score \| Full Scorecard| Match Scorecard)$
examples: India vs Australia Live Score Ball by Ball
Mumbai Indians vs Chennai... Final Score | Full Scorecard

description.description: Meta description for search result snippets
examples: Bangladesh vs Afghanistan live score, ball by ball commentary, latest runs, wickets, overs, and match updates.
India vs Australia final score, full scorecard, match summary, and highlights on VictoryLine.

canonicalUrl.description: Canonical URL for this match page (prevents duplicate content)

ogTitle.description: Open Graph title for social media sharing (Facebook, LinkedIn)
examples: India vs Australia Live Score Ball by Ball

ogDescription.description: Open Graph description for social media previews
examples: Bangladesh vs Afghanistan live score, ball by ball commentary, latest runs, wickets, overs, and match updates.

twitterCard.description: Twitter card type (always summary_large_image for match pages)

twitterTitle.description: Twitter card title (same as main title)

twitterDescription.description: Twitter card description (same as meta description)

jsonLd.description: Schema.org structured data (JSON-LD format) for rich results

name.description: Full match name with team names

startDate.description: Match start date/time in ISO 8601 format

examples.title: Bangladesh vs Afghanistan Live Score Ball by Ball
examples.description: Bangladesh vs Afghanistan live score, ball by ball commentary, latest runs, wickets, overs, and match updates.
